Hyundai Bayon SUV Bookings Open in India

Hyundai Motor India has officially commenced bookings for its upcoming SUV, the Hyundai Bayon, with an initial token amount of ₹11,000. The vehicle is expected to be launched soon and will be positioned between the Venue and Creta models. The Bayon will feature a stylish design, advanced features, and an AI voice assistant. It will be equipped with a petrol engine, and reports suggest a CNG option may also be available. The interior is expected to be inspired by the new i20.
